We need answer JSON with evaluations for each story. Need apply QUS Minimal criterion. Need be careful. We need classify violation when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information extra to role, means, ends. We need evaluate all 69. Need identify violations.

We need consider "Minimal" scope individual. The user story sentence should contain nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. Violation if includes extra stuff: comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, etc.

We need parse each story. Many stories have malformed "so that" duplicated, grammar, but Minimal specifically extra info. We shouldn't penalize duplicates? "so that so we..." is syntactic? Minimal says contains nothing more than role, means, and optional ends/rationale. Duplicate "so that" maybe not extra information? Maybe syntactic issue but not Minimal if still role means ends. But some stories include list of mock-up details etc. Need identify those.

Let's go through each.

BC-001: "As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of sponsors, so that I can thank all the awesome sponsors." Role means ends only. No violation.

BC-002: similar only role means ends. No violation.

BC-003: "As a trainingcoordinator, I want to email all the trainers at once from the website for info and updates, so that It is easier to use." Role means ends. No violation. "It is easier to use" rationale maybe vague but still ends. No extra.

BC-004: "As a attendee, I want to have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are, so that I can make it to class on time." Role means ends. No violation.

BC-005: "As a trainer, I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." Wait ends includes "and links to slides" after so that? It says "so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." The phrase "and links to slides" seems additional means? The story core includes "links to slides" maybe extra information? Need assess. It is a means? "I want to edit my training node myself ... and links to slides." Could be additional requirement embedded, not part of role/means/ends? The original: "I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." This seems "links to slides" is an extra thing, maybe included in means? The story says wants to edit training node and links to slides? Not clear, but extra info beyond role means ends? The phrase "and links to slides" is appended after rationale, not a rationale. Could be extra requirement. Minimal violation? I think yes: "links to slides" is not role/means/ends, it's an extra desire. But need be careful: is "links to slides" part of means? Could mean "edit my training node myself and links to slides" as means. But syntactically attached to "so that ... don't have to and links to slides." It is ambiguous. Minimal violation likely because extra information (links to slides) not in rational. But maybe not "comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes." Additional requirement maybe violates minimal.

BC-006: "As a trainee, I want to limit to one registration per day per authenticated user, so that we don't have duplicate spaces." Role means ends only. No violation. "limit to one registration per day per authenticated user" means includes rule, okay.

BC-007: "As a trainingcoordinator, I want to have an admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee so that, so that we can see if attendend, refunded, no show." Role means ends. But extra "so that, so that" duplicate. That's a grammatical issue not extra info? Minimal no? It contains only role means ends. Duplicate "so that" maybe does not add extra information, maybe not violation. But could be "so that, so that" extra text? The criterion says contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. The duplicate "so that" is not role means ends? Hmm if literally nothing more than role means ends, extra "so that" is extra but not information? But operational rule specifically extra info (comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes). Duplicated connector isn't likely. No violation.

BC-008: "As a attendee, I want to be added to a training waitlist, so that so they can be considered for a class." Similar duplicate so. No extra info. No violation.

BC-009: "As a trainee, I want to must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox, so that they can be accountable.." Role means ends. "must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox" includes implementation detail checkbox? Is "with a checkbox" implementation/testing hint? It is a UI detail. Minimal violation? The core story includes "with a checkbox", which is UI implementation detail. Operational decision: violation when core includes implementation hints, mock-up notes, etc. "with a checkbox" is UI implementation hint. Yes violation.

BC-010: "As a trainingcoordinator, I want to tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists, so that so we don't loose money or spots." Duplicate so. That's all. No extra. But "whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists" vague but means. No violation.

BC-011: "As a trainee, I want to add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site, so that they can schedule their event experience." Role means ends. Contains "if there is a schedule feature on the site" as condition maybe extra? Is condition part of means? Could be requirement statement "add to my schedule if there is a schedule feature" may be extra? But it's within means, conditional. Not implementation hints. No violation.

BC-012: "As a trainee, I want to see which trainings I have signed up for, so that they can schedule their event experience." Role means ends. No violation.

BC-013: "As a trainer, I want to have a view that is attached to their training node that shows all attendee information Trainers can see all class attendance at first because there are so little trainers and they are trusted with privacy, so that the training coordinator doesn't have to do all the work to get login info for environment setup." This includes extra sentence: "Trainers can see all class attendance at first because there are so little trainers and they are trusted with privacy" inserted before "so that". That's a comment or rationale? Not role-means-ends? It is additional rationale/procedural note. Violation. Also "for environment setup" maybe rationale but extra sentence definitely violation.
